cases.description: The sections array is defined for indices 0‑3; providing the exact length (4) should trigger an out‑of‑bounds access.

If the Message object's internal `sections` array is explicitly set to null (e.g., via reflection or a constructor that allows it), the first array access `sections[section]` triggers a NullPointerException before any other logic runs.

When the target `sections[1]` entry is pre‑populated with an unmodifiable list such as `Collections.emptyList()` (or `Collections.unmodifiableList(new LinkedList<>())`), the call to `sections[section].add(r)` fails with an UnsupportedOperationException. The header count is still incremented before the exception is raised.

group: addRecord – header.incCount throws IllegalArgumentException for out‑of‑range section
